title: Refrigeration Service Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Commercial Refrigeration Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Refrigeration Service Inspection Checklist covers compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents. The refrigeration service coordinator records Commercial Refrigeration Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Refrigeration Service Inspection Checklist keeps Commercial Refrigeration Service exceptions visible until the refrigeration service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Refrigeration Service Inspection Checklist at walk-in, reach-in, display case, machine area, and affected product zone. Document compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents identity before Commercial Refrigeration Service begins. Compare compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents findings with stated Commercial Refrigeration Service criteria; route unresolved Commercial Refrigeration Service issues to qualified refrigeration supervisor. For Refrigeration Service Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Commercial Refrigeration Service. Ask qualified refrigeration supervisor to review Commercial Refrigeration Service conditions beyond the refrigeration service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Commercial Refrigeration Service, identify responsible parties, walk-in, reach-in, display case, machine area, and affected product zone, and the linked compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents source.

fields.label: Make, model, serial, refrigerant designation, and circuit
Required range, product status, and alarm history

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Commercial Refrigeration Service facts for compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Commercial Refrigeration Service inspection checks
items: Product and air temperature at defined points
Door, gasket, drain, fan, coil, and airflow condition
Compressor, condenser, control, and defrost indication
Visible tubing, oil residue, frost pattern, and leak concern
Alarm, sensor, setpoint, and monitoring response

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Commercial Refrigeration Service evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Refrigeration Service Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Food or product disposition not assigned
System cannot maintain the required range
Product hold, release, or disposition record
blocks.guidance: Pause Commercial Refrigeration Service when temperature control, refrigerant integrity, product disposition, or alarm protection is unresolved. Retain the available Commercial Refrigeration Service proof and route unresolved compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents scope to refrigeration service coordinator.
